title: Multiple Stopping Options on a Geometric Random Walk
summary: This article develops a finite-horizon multiple-stopping framework and applies it to three American-style contracts on a geometric random walk in a Cox--Ross--Rubinstein market: an American put, a Russian option, and a floating-strike geometric-average Asian put. The general problem is represented by recursively defined Snell envelopes, with unused exercise rights encoded by a cemetery time; this yields an ordered optimal exercise vector without requiring all rights to be exercised.
